_comment: The Events archive, one entry per Instagram announcement (2019-2026). Drafted from each post's caption; every when/time/venue was checked as a literal quote of the caption. build.js renders the archive on /events/ from this list.

items.title: Gurbani Santhiya Camp 2026
items.summary: Five days of Gurbani Santhiya focused on pronunciation, clarity, understanding and connection with Gurbani, presented by Shaheedi Bunga. Limited spaces.

items.title: Gurbani Kirtan & Santhiya Camp
items.venue: Gurdwara Dashmesh Darbar, Gypsy Lane, Leicester
items.summary: Shaheedi Bunga presents a Gurbani Kirtan and Santhiya Camp in Leicester, for those wanting to refine Santhiya or immerse themselves in Kirtan.

items.title: 7-Day Saptah Paath & Kamai Camp
items.summary: A seven-day Saptah Paath and Kamai Camp of Seva, Simran and Sangat, in celebration of the Avtar Purabs of Guru Sahiban and the Avtar Dihara of Sahibzada Baba Jujhar Singh Ji. All are welcome.

items.title: Hola Mohalla War Games 2026
items.venue: Gurdwara Dashmesh Darbar, Gypsy Lane, Leicester
items.summary: Patshahi Dasvi National Tournament with Gatka and Tag Archery competitions, Sri Akal Ustat Path, and Sri Dasam Guru Granth Sahib Ji Bhog.

items.title: Gurbani Santhiya Camp – Mastering the Divine Sound
items.summary: Shaheedi Bunga presents a Gurbani Santhiya Camp, Mastering the Divine Sound, to learn, reflect and connect with Gurbani. Limited spaces.

items.title: Sikhi Camp 2025
items.summary: A weekend Sikhi Camp for ages 5–18 with Gatka, arts and crafts, talks, dastaar tying, sports and more.

items.title: Monday Night Talks: Patsahi 9 – The Silent Light of Strength
items.venue: Guru Tegh Bahadur Gurdwara Sahib, 106 East Park Road, LE5 4QB
items.summary: Monday Night Talk on Patsahi 9, The Silent Light of Strength, by Giani Baljinder Singh (Shaheedi Bunga UK).

items.title: Monday Night Talks: Early Life of Sri Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji
items.venue: Guru Tegh Bahadur Gurdwara Sahib, 106 East Park Road, LE5 4QB
items.summary: Monday Night Talk on the early life of Sri Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji, by Bhai Harjit Singh (Shaheedi Bunga UK).

items.title: Monday Night Talks: Early Life of Patshahi 9 (Adhyai 22-29)
items.venue: Guru Tegh Bahadur Gurdwara Sahib, 106 East Park Road, LE5 4QB
items.summary: Monday Night Talk on the early life of Patshahi 9 (Adhyai 22-29) by Bibi Gagan Kaur (Shaheedi Bunga UK), followed by Pizza Langar.

items.title: Weekly Sikhi Classes Across Leicester’s Gurudwaras
items.summary: A weekly round-up of Gurbani, Kirtan, Santhiya, Gatka, tabla, Jori and Itihaas classes, plus Monday Night Talks, at several Leicester gurdwaras. Gur Panth Parkash classes are listed as coming soon.

items.title: Shaheedi Bunga Kids Sikhi Camp
items.summary: Three-day kids camp with bouncy castles, Kirtan, wrestling and self-defence, arts and crafts, talks, kabaddi and more. Open to all kids; register via the QR code.

items.title: Monday Night Talks: Early Life of Patshahi 9 (Adhyai 15-21)
items.venue: Guru Tegh Bahadur Gurdwara Sahib, 106 East Park Road, LE5 4QB
items.summary: Monday Night Talk on the early life of Patshahi 9 (Adhyai 15-21) by Bhai Baljinder Singh (Shaheedi Bunga UK), followed by Pizza Langar.

items.title: Patshahi Dasvi National Hola Mohalla UK 2025 Gurmat Smagam
items.summary: An evening of Katha and Kirtan for the Patshahi Dasvi National Hola Mohalla UK 2025 Gurmat Smagam.

items.title: Series of Talks
items.summary: A series of talks led by Sikh speakers on Sikh history and the spiritual journey, every Monday evening, with Pizza Langar included.

items.title: Hola Mohalla UK 2025 National War Games Tournament
items.summary: National War Games Tournament inspired by the traditions of Sri Guru Gobind Singh Ji, with horse riding, archery, gatka, axe throwing, rifle shooting, tag archery, knife and chakar throwing.

items.title: Sikhi Camp 2025
items.venue: Gurdwara Shri Guru Dashmesh Sahib, Leicester
items.summary: A full-day camp for kids aged 5 and above with a Shastar Workshop, Dastaar Tying, sports and martial arts, and arts and crafts. Register via the poster QR code.

items.title: National Sikh Archery Tournament 2025
items.venue: Guru Tegh Bahadur Gurdwara, 106 East Park Road, Leicester, LE5 4QB
items.summary: Archery tournament for ages 10–15 (10 metres) and 16+ (15 metres). Registration is by link or WhatsApp.

items.title: Dasam Darbar
items.venue: Sri Guru Dashmesh Darbar Gurudwara, Leicester
items.summary: A Dasam Darbar commemorating the Parkash Purab of Sri Guru Gobind Singh Ji and honouring the Shaheeds of the month of Poh. Families and friends invited.

items.title: Sikhi Camp 2024
items.summary: A two-day Sikhi Camp for ages 5+ with a bouncy castle, activities, sports, and arts and crafts. Registration by link.

items.title: Gurta Gaddi Sri Guru Ram Das Ji and Joti Jot Sri Guru Amar Das Ji
items.summary: Two occasions with Sukhmani Sahib paath, Katha and Kirtan: Gurta Gaddi of Sri Guru Ram Das Ji (16 Sept) and Joti Jot of Sri Guru Amar Das Ji (18 Sept, Wednesday).

items.title: Inter-Akhara Gatka Fight Night
items.summary: First inter-akhara Gatka Fight Night by Shaheed Bhai Mani Singh Ji Gatka Akhara and Shaheedi Bunga, with an exhibition match between two ustads and three student fights, held in memory of an ustad's 20th barsi.

items.title: Gatka Fight Night
items.venue: Guru Tegh Bahadur Gurdwara, Leicester UK
items.summary: An evening of Gatka fights dedicated to the Avtar Purb of Dhan Dhan Baba Deep Singh Ji, with displays of swordplay and stick fighting.

items.title: Gurpurab of Sri Guru Gobind Singh Ji
items.venue: Gurudwara Shri Guru Dashmesh Darbar, Leicester
items.summary: A three-day Gurpurab celebration of Sri Guru Gobind Singh Ji with Dasam Baani Jaap, Kirtan, Katha and Kavishri, live-streamed on YouTube.

items.title: Sikhi Camp
items.summary: A summer Sikhi Camp for all ages with workshops, speakers, morning Simran, activities, Kirtan and Gurbani, Langar Sewa and networking. Limited spots.

items.title: Gurbani Vidhya Camp 2023
items.venue: Gurdwara Guru Tegh Bahadur, 106 East Park Rd, Leicester LE5 4QB
items.summary: Second Gurbani Vidhya Camp: Shudh Ucharan of Bhai Gurdas Ji's Vaars, Katha workshops by Gursikh Vidhvaans including Sant Hari Singh Ji Randhawe Wale, Kirtan and Shastar Vidhya workshops with horseriding.

items.title: Patshahi Dasvi National Hola Mohalla UK 2023 Competitions
items.venue: Gurdwara Panth Parkash, 19 Ashford Road, Leicester
items.summary: Hola Mohalla competition day: 11am Sri Dasam Guru Granth Sahib Ji Bhog and Diwan, 12:30pm Mahalla, 1pm registration and tournament, 5pm trophies.

items.title: 25 Singh Lareevaar Sri Akhand Paath Samagam
items.summary: Akhand Paath Samagam commemorating the Shaheedi Purab of Sri Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji and a barsi; Amrit Sanchar on Saturday, Sehaj Paath Bhog and Raag Darbar at 6pm, and Bhog with Mahan Smagam on Sunday.

items.title: Shaheedi Bunga Akhara Gatka Classes
items.summary: Weekly Shaheedi Bunga Akhara Gatka classes, every Saturday from 6pm.

items.title: Gurbani Vidhya Camp Summer 2020
items.summary: A six-week Gurbani Vidhya Camp starting 18th July, with several teaching accounts tagged.

items.title: Shaheedi Bunga Akhara Archery Classes
items.summary: Weekly Shaheedi Bunga Akhara Archery classes, every Sunday from 6pm.

items.title: Patshahi Dasvi National Hola Mohalla UK 2022 Competition
items.summary: Hola Mohalla competition in Leicester with sign-up by online form, where participants choose their activity.

items.title: Akhand Paat Sahib
items.summary: An Akhand Paat Sahib marking a first Shaheedi Barsi, with the sangat from across the UK invited to attend. Held at Holy Bones, Leicester.

items.title: Sikhi Camp
items.summary: A Sikhi Camp for Sri Guru Gobind Singh Ji Avatar Purab.

items.title: 25 Singh Lareevaar Sri Akhand Paath Samagam
items.summary: Akhand Paath Samagam for the Shaheedi Purab of Sri Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji and Gurgadhi Purab of Sri Guru Gobind Singh Ji; Amrit Sanchar Saturday, Sehaj Paath Bhog and Raag Darbar at 6pm, Bhog Sunday 9am with Katha and Kirtan.

items.title: Mahan Shaheedi Smagam
items.summary: Sri Akhand Paath Sahib in memory of two Shaheeds, from Arambh on 22nd to Bhog on 24th October 2021, followed by Kirtan, Kavisher and Dhadi.

items.title: Monthly Raag Keertan
items.summary: Monthly Raag Keertan by Shaheedi Bunga Jatha UK, commemorating the Gurgaddi Divas of Sri Guru Ram Daas Ji Maharaj and the Joti Jot Divas of Sri Guru Amar Das Ji Maharaj.

items.title: 25 Singh Larivaar Sri Akhand Paath Sahib
items.summary: 25 Singh Larivaar Akhand Paath Sahib for the Sampooranta Divas of Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji, Bhog on Sunday 8th, with Sehaj Paath Bhog of Sri Guru Dasam Granth Sahib Ji on Saturday 7th at 6pm followed by Raag Darbar.

items.title: 25 Singh Sri Akhand Path Sahib
items.summary: 25 Singh Akhand Path Sahib in celebration of the Sampoortha of Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji, Bhog Sunday 9am, with Sri Dasam Guru Granth Sahib Ji Sehaj Path Bhog Saturday 6pm followed by Raag Darbar.

items.title: Shaheedi Jorh Mela
items.summary: A Shaheedi Jorh Mela in memory of a Shaheed Jathedar, inviting the sangat to unite, learn and be part of the Sikh struggle against injustice. Held at Holy Bones, Leicester.

items.title: Shaheedi Bunga Gurmat Vidayala
items.summary: Weekly Santhiya classes every Sunday 12-2pm, plus Kirtan classes 1-2pm (harmonium, dilruba, sarangi, taus, rabab), and beginners' tabla and Jori classes.

items.title: Raag Darbar
items.summary: Raag Darbar for the 400th Parkash Purab of Sri Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji: Sehaj Paath Bhog from 5pm, Rehras Sahib, Aarti, Katha by Giani Baljinder Singh Ji, then Raag Kirtan Darbar with named kirtanis. Streamed online.

items.title: Gurmat Smagam In Sunderland
items.summary: A Gurmat Smagam in Sunderland on 23rd November.

items.title: Sri Akhand Paath Sahib
items.venue: Gurdwara Sri Dasmesh Sahib, 40-50 Gipsy Lane, Leicester
items.summary: Sri Akhand Paath Sahib carried out by 25 Singhs and Vidyarthis of Shaheedi Bunga Gurmat Vidyalai (Uk); the sangat is invited to take part in seva.

items.title: Sri Akhand Paath Sahib
items.venue: Sri Dashmesh Sahib Gurdwara, Gipsy Lane, Leicester
items.summary: Sri Akhand Paath Sahib in memory of the Shaheeds of 1984 and for the Shaheedi Purb of Sri Guru Arjan Dev Ji Maharaaj, carried out by Singhs and Vidyarthis. Caption is in Panjabi and English.
